messages.subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: number of observations (105) too small to compute Gamma

On 07/23/2015 02:37 PM, Stephane Rothen wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I would like to know what is the minimum sample size (if it's based on a
> minimum) or the rule that generates this warning.

For future reference: lavaan computes the dimension (ie, number of
rows/cols, say, 'pstar') needed for the Gamma matrix, and issues a
warning if the sample size (N) is smaller (ie N < pstar).

For continuous data, pstar = nvar*(nvar+1)/2, where nvar is the number
of observed variables. If a meanstructure is needed, pstar = pstar + nvar.

See file lav_samplestats.R (around lines 320) for the exact logic.

Yves.
